narrative.northStar: The Editorial Research Workbench (descriptive implementation label)
narrative.overview: A light, restrained workspace pairs serif analytical headings with compact system-font controls. Pale paper surfaces, ruled sections and open chart areas support sustained inspection of assumptions and evidence. This is a record of the implemented direction, not a claim of separate brand approval.
keyCharacteristics: Green base-case and terracotta scenario marks

rules.name: The Series Identity Rule
rules.body: Preserve green base and terracotta scenario semantics, with dashed scenario lines and explicit labels.

dos: Do reuse the existing typography and paper surfaces.
Do retain accessible chart descriptions and exact-value tables.
Do mark stale results and disable invalid exports.
donts: Don't present edited assumptions as already calculated.
Don't rely on color alone for scenario identity.
Don't invent additional user design approval.
